name: YuE2 - Text to Music
description: YuE2 text-to-music with native vocals and instrumental accompaniment.
notes: The saved workflow promotes a `ckpt_name` widget on the subgraph. Its active value is `yue2_3b_bf16.safetensors`, even though the inner loader and the Markdown note mention the int8 file.
To switch the workflow to the int8 checkpoint, also download `Comfy-Org/YuE2/checkpoints/yue2_3b_int8_convrot.safetensors`.
The old `install_ace_step_1.5_models.sh` script is unrelated to this workflow; ACE-Step is not used by YuE2.
